nodes.label: Skill bucket taxonomy (engineering / productivity / misc / personal / in-progress / deprecated)
nodes.rationale: Only promoted buckets (engineering, productivity) ship: they must appear in README.md and plugin.json; misc, personal, in-progress, deprecated must not.

nodes.label: Plugin version sync (plugin.json <-> package.json)
nodes.rationale: The repo is its own single-plugin Claude Code marketplace; Claude uses the plugin version to decide when installed users see an update, so plugin.json's version must stay in sync with package.json's. Validate with claude plugin validate . --strict.

nodes.label: Docs pages (aihero.dev/skills-<name>)
nodes.rationale: Promoted skills have a human-facing docs page at docs/<bucket>/<skill>.md (docs tree mirrors the two bucket folders); published URL is aihero.dev/skills-<name> regardless of bucket. Non-promoted buckets get no docs page.

nodes.label: ask-matt router maintenance rule
nodes.rationale: Whenever you add, rename, remove, or change how a user-reachable skill fits the flows, re-read ask-matt's SKILL.md and update it - a new skill it never mentions, or a stale one it still routes to, is a router that lies.
